body.label: Effect
body.html: Call an Ancestor's counsel for one ally within 5 units. It becomes Rallied and gains +1 Defense until its next turn.

surges.html: If you used another Calling subtype earlier this round, gain +1 Defense until your next turn.
Move 1 Stamina, Focus, or Mana between you and an affected willing ally, respecting maximums.

rider.title: ANCESTOR — FULL MANIFESTATION
rider.html: If you spent at least 5 dice on this Action, as it resolves you may spend 3 additional Mana to fully manifest your Ancestor.
